title: HELM: Compiler-Guided Heterogeneous Execution for Large Language Models on Memory-Constrained Systems (Artifact)
description: Artifact for the paper 'HELM: Compiler-Guided Heterogeneous Execution for Large Language Models on Memory-Constrained Systems'. Contains the HELM compiler and runtime (roofline-based CPU-GPU partition search, static per-device FX graphs, AVX2+F16C GEMV kernel, paged KV cache with streaming attention), benchmark harnesses for vLLM / Hugging Face Accelerate / DeepSpeed ZeRO-Inference / llama.cpp, single-command experiment drivers, a CPU-only test suite, canonical paper results in machine-readable form, and a validator comparing fresh runs against the paper (see ARTIFACT.md and REPRODUCING.md). Paper: IEEE TCAD, doi:10.1109/TCAD.2026.3729371.
